[1/5] Qwen M5 replication on local qwen2.5-0.5b file: 1.1 vs 1.0 on 48 code items, greedy; run1 36/48 vs 35/48 (2 fixed 3 broken p=1.0), run2 33/48 vs 35/48 (5 fixed 3 broken p=0.73); effect small and n.s., same as SmolLM2; keep search axis [1..1.2], no default change

[1/6] sampler profiles with low top-p combos, drop freq/presence axes for code; [2/6] code repeat-1.0 default + DRY axis wiring + sampler-order fingerprint; [3/6] mixed K/V grid points, thoughtTokens steps, prefix/stop axis; [4/6] give-up metric + prompt pruning; [5/6] engine validation deferred until pilot done; [6/6] full tests, ADR, CHANGELOG, report

impact_assessment.why: Lit review finds top-p dominates T for code, RP harms code, K-q8/V-q4 Pareto, thinking caps, prefix+stop recipes; none are in the tuner grid
impact_assessment.benefits: Sampler grid covers literature-optimal regions; code defaults stop paying the RP tax; DRY/KV/thinking/prefix knobs become measurable; engine runs deferred so pilot timings stay clean
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tune-grid steps change search behavior, TUNER_VERSION bump marks profiles stale; dependency: node-llama-cpp DRY/KV/pass-through must exist or axis is dead; concurrency: no engine runs while pilot tunes; state: grid-only changes, no profile migration
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests per milestone; TUNER_VERSION bump for staleness; engine validation as deferred milestone after pilot; code-only changes, no model loads
